chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:

I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the prescribed inheritance share of the grandfather. He said: “I do not know anyone among the people who spoke about it except by personal opinion, except ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, for he spoke about it according to the saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.بِالرَّأْيِ: by personal opinion or individual reasoning
key_terms.بِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ: in accordance with the statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَرِيضَةِ الْجَدِّ: the prescribed inheritance share of the grandfather

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about the grandfather’s inheritance share?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal question of the grandfather’s inheritance share. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that people generally spoke on this matter by personal opinion, while Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام alone spoke on the basis of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, underscoring the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5624 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about the inheritance share (fariḍah) of the grandfather.
Imam (as) replied: "I do not know anyone among the people who has spoken about it except based on personal opinion, except for Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), for He (as) spoke about it according to the saying of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family)."
